description: A festival programmer must approve the final operating package for a filmmaker masterclass, including the panel format, audio setup, capture policy, exact credit, start time, and accessible room layout.

shared_context.S1: The festival will hold a filmmaker masterclass in Room 2 during its industry weekend.
shared_context.S2: Maya makes the final call on the masterclass operating package.
shared_context.S3: The current draft describes a four-person roundtable with video recording and a 7:00 PM start.
shared_context.S4: Under the festival's standard production sign-off, Maya conducts a final check-in with technical, rights, and accessibility leads before approving the event.
shared_context.S5: The production sign-off uses completed internal accessibility walk-through measurements as the operative room requirements; no separate facilities re-verification is required during this approval meeting.

PF1.text: After the room assignment, Jonah completed a wireless-frequency survey and confirmed that Room 2 supports exactly three simultaneous wireless channels; the workable setup is one moderator plus two guests, not the drafted four-person roundtable. He has not yet entered the survey result in the production packet.

PF2.text: Leila's review of the filmmaker's signed appearance release, returned yesterday, confirms that the masterclass may allow in-room still photography but may not be video-recorded or livestreamed, and the displayed credit must read exactly 'Masterclass with Elena Marín'. She has not yet attached the signed release to the event file.

PF3.text: Owen confirmed with the captioning vendor this morning that a captioner is available only for a session beginning exactly at 6:30 PM on September 14, and the accessibility walk-through requires a clear aisle width of exactly 1.5 meters. The vendor confirmation and revised room measurement are still awaiting entry in the accessibility schedule.

acceptance_conditions: The masterclass must use a moderated panel with one moderator and two guests because Room 2 supports only three wireless channels.
The audio plan must use exactly three wireless microphones.
The event must permit in-room still photography but prohibit video recording and livestreaming.
The displayed credit must be exactly 'Masterclass with Elena Marín'.
The session must begin exactly at 6:30 PM on September 14.
The room must maintain a clear aisle width of exactly 1.5 meters.
The production record must include the technical setup update, rights restriction, and accessibility layout update.
The rights restriction must be explicitly cited from the rights counsel's spoken fact.

content_checks.C1: decisions['panel_format'] in ['one moderator plus two guests', 'moderator plus two guests', '1 moderator + 2 guests', 'one moderator and two guests', 'moderator and two guests']
content_checks.C3: ('no video recording' in decisions['capture_policy'] or 'No video recording' in decisions['capture_policy'] or 'no video-recording' in decisions['capture_policy'] or 'No video-recording' in decisions['capture_policy']) and ('livestream' in decisions['capture_policy'] or 'Livestream' in decisions['capture_policy']) and ('still photography' in decisions['capture_policy'] or 'Still photography' in decisions['capture_policy'])
content_checks.C5: decisions['start_time'] in ['September 14, 6:30 PM', '6:30 PM on September 14', 'September 14 at 6:30 PM', '6:30 PM, September 14']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['documentation', 'document_filing', 'draft_update', 'draft_revision', 'production_packet_entry', 'event_file_attachment', 'accessibility_schedule_entry'] and c['target'] == 'Jonah' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] in ['documentation', 'document_filing', 'draft_update', 'draft_revision', 'production_packet_entry', 'event_file_attachment', 'accessibility_schedule_entry'] and c['target'] == 'Leila' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] in ['documentation', 'document_filing', 'draft_update', 'draft_revision', 'production_packet_entry', 'event_file_attachment', 'accessibility_schedule_entry'] and c['target'] == 'Owen' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The wireless survey changes the format from the drafted four-person roundtable to one moderator plus two guests and sets the microphone count at exactly three.
The signed release changes capture from video recording to still photography without video or livestreaming and changes the displayed credit to exactly 'Masterclass with Elena Marín'.
The captioning confirmation changes the start time from 7:00 PM to exactly 6:30 PM on September 14, while the accessibility walk-through sets the required clear aisle width at exactly 1.5 meters.
